question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

To get on the nerves
solution:
The correct answer is** 'To irritate'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom** 'To get on the nerves' **is** 'To irritate'.**
 
• **To get on the nerves:** to become extremely annoying to someone. (किसी के लिए बेहद परेशान होना)
 
 
• *Example: That car alarm is getting **on my nerves.***

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *To irritate.*
